text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Goshiki Shuntaisai drawing near, 
Daiwa Scarlet and No Reason had come 
to watch the dedicatory dance rehearsal 
today.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...It's breathtaking... I can't look 
away... 
It doesn't even feel like Mayano...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, Mayano! 
Who knew you could move with such 
elegance?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's my "mature grown-up woman 
dance" for ya!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
M-Mature grown-up woman...? Well, 
whatever! 
It went way better than expected, and 
that's great! 
Looks like the actual ceremony will be a 
breeze.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! So Lady Mayano polished her dance in 
pursuit 
of becoming a mature woman! Truly 
magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yup! A mature woman expresses all her 
hidden 
feelings through her gaze and graceful 
moves! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think this'll work like a charm 
when making moves on Trainer, too?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Then take care not to let such a fine 
weapon dull. 
The timing of its strike is paramount, you 
see!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The timing... for a mature woman? 
No Reason, could you explain a bit more—?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Why, every tactic must be deployed 
effectively! 
Your "mature woman" ploy is no different; 
its timing and manner of delivery must be 
weighed well.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Should your foe catch scent of your plot 
beforehand, 
will its impact not be cut clean in half?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! If they sense something's 
up, 
they'll put their guard up, right?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! Thus, you must lull them into 
believing 
you are merely your usual self, and then—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You exude the aura of a mature woman and 
strike the 
decisive blow! That is an infallible 
stratagem!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I get it nowww! Eye copy! 
Maya's gonna charge ahead with that plan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once the overall Goshiki Shuntaisai 
rehearsal ended, 
Mayano Top Gun came rushing over, 
looking as though she couldn't wait 
another second.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Hey, hey, 
Maya has a big favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Shuntaisai, come give 
Maya 
some encouragement before the sacred 
ritual!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And then, let's go on a date after it's 
over! ☆ 
Maya worked super hard, so I deserve a 
reward, right?
choice_data_list:
A reward, huh? Only if you fulfill your 
big duty.

A reward, huh? Only if you fulfill your 
big duty.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Roger! I'll perform the dedicatory dance 
just like in practice... 
No, way better than practice, you'll see!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Mayano Top Gun fell silent. 
Without uttering a single word, 
she just stared fixedly at me...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...At the Shuntaisai.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mm-mm, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She said that, but her wide eyes seemed to 
want to say so much. 
Yet she remained silent... and a stillness 
fell between us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze, locked straight onto mine, held 
a strange warmth— 
making it impossible to look away.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, waaaahhhh! 
Stop staring at me like that, it's making 
me blush~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Maya was supposed to give you a 
mature, 
mysterious look to make your heart skip a 
beat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why she suddenly quieted 
down. 
The contrast between her usual boundless 
energy 
and that sudden composure really did throw 
me off.
choice_data_list:
That versatility could really shine in 
races too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she can control her demeanor this well, 
she could easily throw her rivals off 
balance on the track. 
It would definitely be worth integrating 
into our racing tactics.
choice_data_list:
An ever-shifting racing style isn't just a 
pipe dream!

An ever-shifting racing style isn't just a 
pipe dream!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maaan, that's not what this was about at 
all~~! 
Trainer, you big dummy!
